title: Buying Windows 95 on Launch Day
creator_notes: Original camera operator and production are not identified anywhere in the source record. 'Vampire Robot' is the YouTube channel that uploaded the video (2022-10-07); the channel's description contains no statement of where its footage comes from. The burned-in drop-frame timecode (e.g. 10:46:14;06) indicates professional video tape, not a consumer upload, but no organisation is named.
original_date: 2022-10-07 (YouTube upload date; date of the upload, not of the footage)
depicted_event_date: 1995-08-24 (claimed by the uploader description only; see evidence/claim-checks.json for corroboration status)
depicted_place_notes: No source states the store location. The frame shows a street-level storefront in a multi-storey urban building; no city is asserted.
access_method: Anonymous HTTPS download from archive.org; no account, terms acceptance, payment, CAPTCHA, or access control involved.
identity_evidence: Decoded frame 462 shows the lettering EGGHEAD SOFTWARE on the storefront glass above the entrance (visible, legible at native 480x360).
A yellow 'Store Hours' card is on the door; its small print is not legible at this resolution and is not relied on.
The uploader description names Egghead Software and CompUSA as the stores filmed; the later CompUSA shots are a different store and are not used here.
version_evidence: Video stream VP9 480x360, 30000/1001 fps, 97.861 s (ffprobe). Downloaded bytes match IA's recorded md5 and sha1 for the file IA marks as original.
credit_text: Archival footage: "Buying Windows 95 on Launch Day" (uploaded by Vampire Robot, 2022), via Internet Archive item youtube-CcbAC4qI9pQ. Original source unknown.
transformations: Decoded a single frame (index 462) losslessly to PNG; no crop.

Editorial frame: integer 3x Lanczos upscale to 1440x1080, centred on a black 1920x1080 canvas (pillarbox). No stretch, no crop, burned-in timecode left in place, no text added. Parameters in evidence/framing.json.
notes: The MP4 in the same IA item is an IA derivative transcode of this WebM; it was used only to locate the shot and is not delivered.
Rights are not cleared. See evidence/rights.json.
